title: What If You Fell Into Uranus? There's No Ground to Hit

scenes.text: What if you fell into Uranus? There is no ground to land on, and it gets stranger.
First, the cold. Uranus has the coldest atmosphere of any planet in the solar system.
Winds there have been measured at over 800 kilometers an hour, with cloud systems thousands of kilometers wide.
Methane in the air gives the whole planet its aquamarine color, mixed with clouds of ammonia and hydrogen sulfide.
Deeper down, the layers get hotter and denser, toward a mantle of hot ammonia and methane fluids thousands of kilometers thick.
You would never find a floor. And the planet is tipped on its side, so each pole gets 42 years of sunlight, then 42 of darkness.

description:
What if you fell into Uranus?
